Global supply constraints for critical minerals, driven by export bans and ESG-driven capex cuts in the West, keep Indonesian producers as the marginal price-setters.

Add AGII for coal-to-clean-energy transition exposure. Trim US-linked energy if dollar weakens. Watch for policy catalysts from the new government's mining royalty review.

Rotate out of US-exposed names (INDR, BACH) as IDR strength and domestic consumption hold. Target UNIC and OPMS for defensive yield; trim GZCO on valuation risk.
